submitted.rationale: Index 13 (Co0.50Sb0.50) had the highest measured EQE, 0.0137%. XRD suggests a single rutile/trirutile-type phase across the Co-rich and mid range, with a second phase appearing at Sb ≥ 0.67. EQE peaked near the middle of the line: the Sb-rich index 18 read about zero and the Co-rich index 7 read 0.0018%.

rejected.reason: Measured EQE about zero (-0.004%); XRD shows a second phase starting near Co:Sb 1:2
Not measured for EQE; XRD shows more of the second phase, and the Sb-rich direction was already poor at index 18
